review_state: Final narrow source fixes independently reviewed and reproduced; no open confirmed findings. Parent combined verification remains a separate gate.

resolved_findings.evidence: Initial frozen packages/core/src/access-operations.ts:258-260 authorized before reads, then :299-316 passed candidate/previous values to adapter.transition without post-read identity validation; settleTransition:185 checked too late.
resolved_findings.refutation: Default startup admits no target adapter, limiting reachability, but a qualified adapter path is part of this module's explicit contract. The final settle check cannot undo a target transition or value handoff already dispatched after completed revocation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Producer added locked post-read dispatch admission at access-operations.ts:313-343, checking fresh actor, live identity/revision/epoch, slot revision/state/versions and the same unresolved operation/adapter. Target I/O remains outside the transaction.

resolved_findings.criterion: COR-04 / immutable task context and usage
resolved_findings.evidence: Initial frozen packages/core/src/access-redemption.ts:69,73-85,101-105,117-129 retained caller-owned context/use references across provider awaits: initial budget charge could use one grant while later validation used another.
resolved_findings.refutation: Private consumers are trusted and the replacement run may have independent valid authority; nevertheless the broker promises to bind the handoff and single charge to one immutable admitted execution context. A mutable alias permitted a cancelled original run to bypass its subsequent live-state validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Producer added detached structuredClone plus strict TaskSnapshot validation at access-redemption.ts:23-48,98-104 before the first await. All later checks and charges use the private parsed snapshot.

resolved_findings.evidence: packages/core/src/access-redemption.ts:178-193 (snapshot-refrozen version): access.material.delivered is appended in the final transaction, then deliver receives material; a callback exception throws PRIVATE_HANDOFF_FAILED inside that transaction and rolls its audit entry back.
resolved_findings.reproduction: Using the in-memory accessFixture and an activated runtime slot, record core.listAudit length, consumeStatic with a callback that compares/copies the fixture material then throws, and record the audit length again. Observed copiedMaterialBeforeException=true, reportedFailure=true, auditEventsBefore=9, auditEventsAfter=9, durableNewAuditEvents=0. No material/proof was printed.
resolved_findings.refutation: The caller is trusted and the failure is sanitized, but neither fact undoes the already received material. Earlier slot/issuance audit records do not establish this access attempt. No separate durable pre-handoff intent exists on the inspected runtime path.
resolved_findings.suggestion: Commit a metadata-only access-attempt intent before private delivery, preserve final locked revoke/cancel admission, and keep callback or commit failure from erasing the only evidence of possible exposure.
resolved_findings.resolution: Producer now commits access.material.handoff_attempted before callback in access-redemption.ts:179-205; final locked transaction revalidates authority and runs the synchronous callback at :206-228. Failures retain the intent and record handoff_unknown or handoff_denied at :229-252, with sanitized audit-unavailable fallback.
